report.summary: TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable when checking user notification preferences because user['preferences'] is None and lacks a null check.
report.root_cause: The function get_user_notification_preference in shopapp/users.py performs a direct dictionary subscript operation user['preferences'][channel] without verifying whether user['preferences'] is None. Commit 1f3a4df refactored out the previous safe null check and .get() fallback, causing a TypeError whenever a user profile exists but has a null preferences attribute.
